title: Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report — Filing Terms for Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts
content:
For the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the quarterly contribution and wage report, and the contributions it reports, are due on the last day of the month after the calendar quarter ends. Employees are counted on the 12th day of each month of the quarter, and an employer whose count is 10 or more files electronically.

## Filing terms by class

| Financing class | Report and contributions due | Employee count reference day | Electronic filing required at | Estimated assessment issued after (calendar days past due date) | Estimated assessment wage uplift |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Contributory — New Employer Standard Rate | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Contributory — New Employer Construction Rate | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Contributory — Experience-Rated Deficit Reserve | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Contributory — Delinquent Reporting Assigned Rate | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |
| Reimbursing — Governmental Entity | Last day of the month after quarter end | 12 | 10 employees or more | 60 | 1.25 |

## Meaning of each column

- **Report and contributions due** — the due date of the report and of the quarter's contributions.
- **Employee count reference day** — the day of each month on which employees are counted for the report; each report shows one count for each of the quarter's three months.
- **Electronic filing required at** — the employee count at or above which reports must be filed electronically, also called the electronic filing threshold.
- **Estimated assessment issued after** — the class's estimated assessment days: the calendar days after the due date of an unfiled report before an estimated assessment is issued.
- **Estimated assessment wage uplift** — the multiple the class applies in an estimated assessment.

## Due dates in a calendar year

| Quarter | Quarter ends | Report due |
|---|---|---|
| First | 31 March | 30 April |
| Second | 30 June | 31 July |
| Third | 30 September | 31 October |
| Fourth | 31 December | 31 January of the next year |

**Counting the estimated assessment days (illustration).** For a first-quarter report due on 30 April, the 60th calendar day after the due date is 29 June.

**Electronic filing threshold, both sides (hypothetical counts).** A report showing 10 employees on a reference day is at the threshold and is filed electronically; a report showing 9 is below it.
